o.text: Probably from Proto-Turkic *ört- (“to cover”), whence also Azerbaijani örtmək (“to cover, veil; to shut”). Cognate with Turkish örek (“blanket, covering; hair knitting”).
Borrowed from Arabic اِعْتِبَارًا (iʕtibāran). By surface analysis, etibar + -ən.
From Persian نام خدا (nâm-e xodâ, literally “the name of the God”).
Borrowed from Russian электромагнетизм (elektromagnetizm). By surface analysis, elektro- + maqnetizm.
